entries.speaker: Newscaster
entries.en: The Public Prosecutor's Office finally[n]decided today to break its long-standing[n]silence.

entries.speaker: Newscaster
entries.en: It seems there was consensus to try[n]Representative Shido for the[n]countless crimes he confessed.

entries.speaker: Newscaster
entries.en: Furthermore, many demands have been[n]made for Representative Shido to resign[n]from his public position.

entries.speaker: Newscaster
entries.en: Nationwide protests have begun in[n]support of holding new elections, and[n]an internet proposal has—

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: ...I'm surprised so much changed in just[n]one night.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: It's pretty impressive.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: But [fName]'s...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Merry Christmas!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Huh? Why do you look so down?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: What're you cryin' about, Futaba?[n]You guys get in a fight or somethin'?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Hey, Ryuji...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: ...What's up with this gloomy vibe?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Where's [fName]?

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Mako-chan, what's wrong?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Um...

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: It's okay. I'll explain.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: What the hell!?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: I don't comprehend. The hero who saved[n]this nation is now living in juvenile hall?

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: It's just how the system works.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Don't let it get to you.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I did my best to discuss the options...[n]but nothing I said could change the[n]outcome...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Dammit! This can't be happenin'!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Are we supposed to just agree to this?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: I can't do that!

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Me neither!

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: I must object as well.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Wanting to interrogate him makes sense...[n]but the measures following were[n]questionable at best.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: All that crap about his record and[n]probation was bullshit! He didn't do[n]any of that!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Won't everything just cancel out if Shido[n]tells the whole truth!?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: That won't be enough. Remember what[n]my sister said before?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: In order to overturn a sentence, you[n]need definitive evidence that proves[n]the subject's innocence.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Evidence!? How're we gonna find[n]anything like that!?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: I mean, the police were in on all that crap[n]too, so any proof they got's prolly been[n]destroyed...

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Futaba, is there any way you can use[n]your computer to find information?

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: I'll do what I can...

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: But don't put too much faith in it. It's not[n]some kinda almighty device.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: The Metaverse doesn't exist anymore[n]either...

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: I wonder what Mona-chan would say[n]if he were here right now...

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: He'd likely laugh and tell us how foolish[n]we all are.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: And he would say it in that high-and-[n]mighty tone of his...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: That guy was real annoyin', but now that[n]he's gone it feels... y'know...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Guess we really did count on him a lot.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: The hope of humanity...

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: I wish I could do something to help our[n]leader...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Hey! Morgana'd be ashamed of us sitting[n]around here moping like this!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Honestly, I don't know what we should[n]do... but if we give up, we'll never save[n][fName]!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Didn't he save all of you!? If we aren't[n]gonna act now, when will we?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: We gotta do something!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Yeah! Now's not the time to be hangin'[n]our heads!

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Hm... What can we do without using[n]the Metaverse?

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Maybe we'll be able to find something[n]if we search around.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Let's just calm down and think about it.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: We've escaped death countless times[n]before... There's no doubt we can do[n]this!

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: That's right! Let's go!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: We're gonna save our leader, no matter[n]what it takes!
